rows.en: Yamato: "Oh... Ai and Bart.
What are they doing?"
Touya: "Hmm? What's all the sneaking around?"
Yamato: "...I'm curious..."
Touya: "..."
Sneak closer and listen in
Walk up normally and say hello
Ai: "...Isn't this different from what you promised?"
Bart: "It's a little different from what you asked for, but the quality is guaranteed."
Ai: "...It certainly seems to be good stuff..."
Bart: "Heh... I'm a professional. I don't offer shoddy goods.
If I can't meet your request, it's only proper to offer a higher grade."
Ai: "And the price...?"
Bart: "Of course, the same is fine."
Ai: "Heh heh..."
Touya: 'What are those two doing?'
Yamato: 'It certainly sounds like that sort of deal...'
Ai: "Then let me try it..."
Bart: "Go ahead."
Touya: "Whoa!"
Yamato: "Ugh... My eyes..."
Ai: "Who?! ...Oh, you two..."
Bart: "Eavesdropping isn't a very nice hobby."
Touya: "Ugh... What was that just now?"
Yamato: "A new kind of neural weapon?"
Ai: "...Of course not!
This. Look."
Touya: "...A camera?"
Ai: "Right. I can't develop film here,
so I chose this one that lets you see the pictures right away.
They come out pretty well, and the film's cheap too."
Touya: "...Hmm? Hey, isn't that the one
they were advertising on TV all the time a while ago?"
Ai: "Yeah. It was pretty popular with us too, so much so
that it was hard to get one. It's different now, though."
Touya: "I'm impressed you got hold of something like this...
Where did you get it...?"
Bart: "Heh... Trade secret."
Touya: "I-I see... Well, fine.
...So, what are you going to do with it?"
Ai: "Nothing in particular."
Touya: "Nothing...?"
Ai: "At first, I planned an 'Ai-chan Memory Album'
project, but it didn't
quite click.
Something more flexible and exciting..."
Yamato: "I think it'd be quicker to rethink trying
to do that with a camera in the first place..."
Ai: "Oh, you think so too? I was starting to think the same thing.
But since I have it, I'll think of some use for it.
Thanks, Bart."
Bart: "Yeah."
Bart: "Well, I'll take my leave too."
Yamato: "...Shall we go too?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Touya: "Hey. What are you two being so secretive about?"
Ai: "How rude! We're not being secretive about anything!"
Bart: "We were just acting out a situation Ai
suggested."
Touya: "Nothing decent, I bet."
Ai: "What's wrong with a shady-broker
scenario?"
Touya: "...So it was nothing decent after all."
Ai: "Shut up!"
Yamato: "...But what exactly were you trading?"
Ai: "This."
Touya: "...A camera?"
Ai: "Right. I can't develop film here,
so I chose an instant camera. The pictures still come out
pretty well, and the film's cheap too."
Touya: "...Hmm? Hey, isn't that the one
they were advertising on TV all the time a while ago?"
Ai: "Yeah. It was pretty popular with us too, so much so
that it was hard to get one. It's different now, though."
Touya: "I'm impressed you got hold of something like this...
Where did you get it...?"
Bart: "Heh... Trade secret."
Touya: "I-I see... Well, fine.
...So, what are you going to do with it?"
Ai: "Nothing in particular."
Touya: "Nothing...?"
Ai: "At first, I planned an 'Ai-chan Memory Album'
project, but it didn't
quite click.
Something more flexible and exciting..."
Yamato: "I think it'd be quicker to rethink trying
to do that with a camera in the first place..."
Ai: "Oh, you think so too? I was starting to think the same thing.
But since I have it, I'll think of some use for it.
Thanks, Bart."
Bart: "Yeah."
Bart: "Well, I'll take my leave too."
Yamato: "Shall we go too?"
Touya: "Yeah."
